tellings.quote: I did I did Iaska once, so I've never done DMT

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says he once took ayahuasca, a psychedelic brew from the Amazon, but has never taken DMT, the strong psychedelic drug found in it. He brings this up while talking with a neuroscientist, Andrew Gallimore, who argues that DMT may open a door to an alien realm.
